_about: Commands & Shortcuts: one shortcut list in three groups (everywhere, message box, terminal) that writes the changed-keys map; hints and clash handling beside it; reset and save/load are the inventory actions; on Commands, the confirm switch first, the command list, and the five command rows as defaults for new commands.

commands-keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
commands-keys.help: Click a shortcut to change it. Clashes are shown in every group.

commands-hints.title: Hints and clashes
commands-hints.help: Show keys next to buttons, and what happens when two share keys.

commands-key-tools.title: Reset and back up
commands-key-tools.help: Put shortcuts back, or save and load them as a file.

commands-behaviour.title: Safety
commands-behaviour.help: Ask for a second step before a high-impact command runs.

commands-list.title: Your commands
commands-list.help: Open a command to change what it sends and how it runs.

commands-defaults.title: Defaults for new commands
commands-defaults.help: A new command starts with these.

commands-builtins.title: Built-in names
commands-builtins.help: Whether your own commands may take a built-in name.
